nodes.question: What policy shift occurred in 2014 with the introduction of Regulation 1306/2013 regarding agricultural practices in peri-urban areas?
nodes.answer: The policy shift in 2014 focused on moving from subsidizing productivity to promoting environmentally friendly agricultural practices, including incentives for environmental protection and conservation.
